question: The compound interest compounded semi-annually at a certain rate on a sum of Rs. 1,25,000 at the end of one and a half years is Rs. 15,608. What would be the simple interest on the same sum of money at the same rate of interest for 3 years?
solution:
Formula used:

P = SI×100over R× T

A = P × (1 + Rover 100)T

CI = A - P where-

P = Principal

SI = Simple Interest

R = Rate

T = Time

CI = Compound Interest

A = Amount

Calculation:

Since the rate is compounded semi-annually, the time would be 3 years

A = 1,25,000 + 15,608 = Rs 1,40,608

1,40,608 = 1,25,000 × (1 + Rover 100)3

⇒ 140608over125000 = (1 + Rover 100)3 

⇒ (52over50)³ = 1 + Rover 100)3 

⇒ 1 + Rover 100 = 52over50

⇒ Rover 100 = 2over50 

⇒ R × 50 = 100 × 2

⇒ R = 4%

Annual rate of interest = 4 × 2 = 8%

SI = 125000 × 8 × 3over100 = Rs 30,000

**∴ The simple interest on the sum is Rs 30,000.**
